name: My Mini Market
summary:
Step into the vibrant world of "My Mini Market," a delightful arcade idle game crafted exclusively for Meta Quest. In this immersive VR experience, you become the proud owner of a bustling mini-market. Start small, managing your shelves and serving happy customers. As you earn coins, unlock unique items, expand your store, and improve your services. The game blends relaxing idle mechanics with engaging arcade elements, creating an addictive loop of progress and fun.
